rationale.consistency: Follows established k6 package layout and naming conventions, mirroring the v6 client closely.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles 409 conflicts correctly, maps all required test exit conditions cleanly, and correctly drains/rewinds request bodies on HTTP retries.
rationale.scope: Implements exactly the requested flow and changes without overstepping boundaries or introducing unrelated refactors.
rationale.readability: Cleanly factored into logical components with clear, descriptive names and helpful package-level and function-level documentation.
rationale.robustness: Carefully handles context cancellations, connection draining, request rewinding for retries, and properly scopes the HTTP clients.
rationale.maintainability: Highly decoupled design; the new fake provisioning server ensures tests will be reliable and easy to maintain.
